.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (task.toml, tests/test.sh, tests/scoring.toml, tests/Dockerfile, environment/Dockerfile, tests/tools/*.py, every judge.toml)
evidence: Measured on the frozen bytes (Python 3.12.10 tomllib, bash -n, Node v24.19.0 --check; nothing written to .qc-cache). TOML: task.toml, tests/scoring.toml and all five judge.toml parse with tomllib with no error; criterion counts 1 (render), 2 (constraints), 42 (functional), 6 (polish), 3 (visual), no duplicate ids, every type is binary or likert (visual likert rows all carry points), every weight > 0 and description non-empty; each [judge] table equals the frozen template's table and [scoring].aggregation matches the template. Every prompt.md holds exactly one {criteria} and one {app_context}; tests/app_context.md has no brace placeholders, so the substitution at tests/test.sh:195-201 is well-formed. Shell: `bash -n` exits 0 for solution/solve.sh and tests/test.sh; both begin `#!/bin/bash`; a byte scan of every file in the task found no CR byte, no BOM, no NUL, no non-UTF-8 file and no file missing its final newline. tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/scoring.toml, tests/Dockerfile, environment/Dockerfile and tests/.dockerignore are byte-identical to the frozen template; task.toml differs from the template only in the CHANGE_ME identity/metadata lines. Python tools parse with ast. JSON: environment/assets/seed_data.json, package.json, package-lock.json and tsconfig.json parse. Reference entry: `node --check solution/app/server.js` passes; package.json sets "type": "commonjs" and server.js uses require() only for node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3, the two packages both Dockerfiles install globally at the pinned versions and expose through NODE_PATH, so the entry resolves without a node_modules directory; it resolves files from __dirname, honours DB_PATH and listens on 0.0.0.0:3000 with /api/health, matching test.sh:97-111 and integration.md:3,9. public/index.html references /assets/index.js and /assets/index.css, both present; the shipped bundle passes node --check. solve.sh asserts `test -f "$source_app/server.js"` and copies the app to /app, the file test.sh:68 requires. Budgets nest: gates 1500 + scored 11100 = 12600 < verifier 13200; judge timeouts 600+600 <= 1500 and 9000+900+900 = 10800 <= 11100. Run evidence: all 22 artifact hashes in raw-evidence-index.json verify; results/runtime.json, editor.json, polish.json and persist-after.json record every scripted check true with pageErrors [] and restart.json shows revision 2 with history [2,1] after a real process restart, with the app installed by solve.sh and launched as test.sh launches it (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH). Limits, stated not waived: that launch ran in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image; no configured judge run exists for these bytes (the hosted Oracle 0.9833 run is an earlier candidate); these are source/parser checks, not an execution of the private deterministic checker suite. Informational only, not a defect of this row: solution/app/src/custom-editor.js is ESM and fails a bare `node --check` under the commonjs package type, but it is a Vite source input, not an entry the verifier executes; both .sh files are git mode 100644, the same as the template, and tests/Dockerfile runs `chmod +x /tests/test.sh`.
